class_id: a shared store keyed without the environment, so one slot reads and overwrites the other's state
feature: every Redis key written or read by any process on either slot (web cache-aside, repository caches, admin/pattern invalidation via KEYS/SCAN, scraper distributed locks scraper:cycle / scraper:live / filing-auto-persist:cycle, scraper last-run cadence keys, and the redis-cli lock reads in scripts/scraper-wake.sh and release in scripts/deploy-linux.sh)
symptom: prod and staging connect to ONE Redis (same host, port, password, db index) while their Postgres databases are separate (ipodhan vs ipodhan_staging). With no slot in the key, any key either slot writes is the other slot's key too: a staging cache write is served on prod, a staging `keys('*')` clear deletes prod's cache, a staging data cycle holding lock:resource:scraper:cycle makes every prod wake skip, a staging deploy's lock release can delete a lock a live prod cycle holds, and a staging last-run cadence key suppresses prod's discovery/document/registrar runs. Wider shape: separating the database but not the cache/lock store in front of it re-couples the environments through the store. Round 1 review (2026-09-26) found the inverse edges of the same class: (a) the shared unprefixed scraper:cycle lock was ALSO what kept the two slots' python extractors off the 2-vCPU box at the same time (W-178, Cloudflare 522s), so namespacing it silently removed a box-wide exclusion; (b) an auto-rollback restarts pre-namespace code, which reads the frozen unprefixed cache keys (up to 7 days old, some without TTL); (c) `next build` has no database env, so a fail-closed factory broke the sitemap prerender (CI job 108374259774).

Evidence: identical REDIS_URL/REDIS_PASSWORD in shared/env/prod and shared/env/staging (GetWorkDone evidence 2026-08-22-T-263/44-redis-config-comparison.log). Lock sharing read from code on 2026-09-26: scraper/src/index.ts:235 CYCLE_LOCK_RESOURCE='scraper:cycle', DistributedLock key 'lock:resource:<id>' (distributed-lock.ts:414) with no slot, and deploy-linux.sh/scraper-wake.sh named the same unprefixed keys.
fix_prs: fix/151-slot-namespaced-cache-keys (Closes #151): every client factory sets ioredis keyPrefix '<slot>:' derived from the connected database (ipodhan -> prod, ipodhan_staging -> staging, else db-<name>), cross-checked against DEPLOY_SLOT, fail-closed without a database; KEYS/SCAN patterns patched on the instance; shell twin scripts/lib/redis-slot-prefix.sh for the deploy/wake lock keys. Round 1: build-time no-cache client only under NEXT_PHASE=phase-production-build with no database (runtime still throws); a deliberate box-wide extractor lock `box:lock:resource:extractor` through getBoxWideRedisClient() (scraper/src/services/extraction-locks.ts, same TTL + signal-path release as the slot extraction lock); the deploy AUTO-ROLLBACK SCANs and UNLINKs unprefixed cache keys by the cache-keys.ts namespaces (never lock:, state, prod:/staging:/box:/db- keys); duplicate() keeps the namespace; the shell twin %-decodes the database name.
detection_check: scripts/ci/check-redis-client-factories.mjs (PR gate) refuses any `new Redis(` outside the four slot-namespaced factories (self-test scripts/tests/check-redis-client-factories.test.mjs, red on a planted client); web/tests/unit/lib/cache/redis-slot-factories.test.ts asserts every factory carries the prefix and throws without a database; packages/shared/src/cache/redis-slot.test.ts proves on the real factory that a staging-written key is invisible to prod and that KEYS/SCAN invalidation stays in-slot; scripts/tests/redis-slot-prefix.test.sh pins the shell twin to the same fixture. Known gap: nothing reads the LIVE Redis to confirm no unprefixed key is still being written after rollout (would need a read-only `redis-cli --scan` on the box, which is an owner-approved ops read, not a CI check). Round 1: the CI grep also pins every getBoxWideRedisClient() caller (BOX_WIDE_CALLERS); scraper/tests/unit/services/extraction-locks.test.ts proves two slots hold their own cycle locks but never the box extractor lock at once; deploy-linux.test.sh case 30k proves the rollback clears only unprefixed cache keys and pins its namespace list to both cache-keys.ts files; redis-slot-factories.test.ts proves the build-time path per factory and that runtime still throws.
